summary: Verified new Message Customer feature and fmtLongDateTime formatter. Backend POST /api/customers/{cid}/message: 404 on unknown id, 400 on missing subject, 400 on missing body, 400 with 'Resend API key is not configured…' descriptive detail when no key set — 4/4 pytest cases pass. Frontend: Customers list Joined column and Customer profile Joined stat both render exact format 'Saturday, 22 Aug 2026 at 8:48 AM' (matches strict regex ^Weekday, D Mon YYYY at H:MM AM|PM$). MessageCustomerDialog: opens from customer-message-btn, To preview shows name + email, Send disabled until subject+body filled, inside click does NOT close, Cancel/X/backdrop all close. Send with no Resend key → dialog stays open + Sonner toast 'Send failed' with backend detail 'Resend API key is not configured. Add it in Store Management › Email & Notifications.'. No regressions observed in customer list/profile flows.

issues: Pre-existing Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning still present when Customers tab initial load; not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: fmtLongDateTime correctly uppercases AM/PM via regex on en-AU locale output — deterministic on the sample data tested.
MessageCustomerDialog properly stops propagation on inner container so inside clicks don't dismiss; backdrop onClick=onClose behaves as spec.
Backend endpoint returns descriptive 400 detail strings (asserted substrings 'not found', 'Resend API key', 'subject/body') — good UX for admin.
Outbound message is inserted with direction='outbound' and status='archived' — audit trail flow is sound; not exercised because Resend key intentionally absent per test note.
Send button is also disabled when customer.email is falsy — nice safety guard.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded customer (TEST_cust_703e5, email test_78fcc@example.com) for profile + send-flow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AsyncMockDB in-memory; restart wipes state. Resend key intentionally not configured — POST /api/customers/{cid}/message returns 400 with detail containing 'Resend API key is not configured'. To exercise the happy-path outbound-log insertion, PATCH /api/push/settings with a resend_api_key first (still likely 502 from Resend itself unless a real key is set). fmtLongDateTime is deterministic under en-AU locale on Linux node runtime; if tests run on a different ICU build, minute padding could differ — current impl uses minute:'2-digit' so ':05' etc are safe.
rca of the issue: N/A — all specified behaviours verified working.
